Data Scientist | Spatial Data Analysis | Computer Vision | Geospatial Intelligence
Experienced Geospatial Data Scientist & GIS Solutions Specialist with over 8 years' tenure. Demonstrated proficiency in remote sensing, raster modeling, spatial analysis, automation, and geospatial data engineering, applied to environmental, territorial, and operational projects. Strong foundation in open-source GIS tools such as QGIS, PostGIS, and Python, bolstered by expertise in ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and ArcPy. Transitioned from desktop GIS and EO workflows to reproducible Python pipelines, web GIS, and PyTorch-based semantic segmentation.
